description: This is a Java test class for the ContextDAO, specifically testing authentication methods such as authenticate with various inputs, session listener triggers, and handling of edge cases in user authentication within the OpenMRS platform.

classes.name: ContextDAOTest
classes.description: JUnit test class verifying the behavior of ContextDAO's authenticate method and session listener triggers in the OpenMRS platform.

methods.name: runExtraSetup
methods.description: Initializes test data and obtains the ContextDAO bean before each test.

methods.name: logOutAfterThisTest
methods.description: Logs out the user after all tests have been executed.

methods.name: authenticate_shouldAuthenticateGivenUsernameAndPassword
methods.description: Tests successful authentication with username 'admin' and password 'test'.

methods.name: authenticate_shouldAuthenticateGivenSystemIdAndPassword
methods.description: Tests successful authentication with system ID '1-8' and password 'test'.

methods.name: authenticate_shouldAuthenticateGivenSystemIdWithoutHyphenAndPassword
methods.description: Tests authentication with system ID '18' (without hyphen) and password 'test'.

methods.name: authenticate_shouldNotAuthenticateGivenUsernameAndIncorrectPassword
methods.description: Ensures authentication fails with correct username but wrong password.

methods.name: authenticate_shouldNotAuthenticateGivenSystemIdAndIncorrectPassword
methods.description: Ensures authentication fails with correct system ID but wrong password.

methods.name: authenticate_shouldNotAuthenticateGivenIncorrectUsername
methods.description: Check authentication failure with an incorrect username.

methods.name: authenticate_shouldNotAuthenticateGivenIncorrectSystemId
methods.description: Check authentication failure with an incorrect system ID.

methods.name: authenticate_shouldNotAuthenticateGivenNullLogin
methods.description: Verify that null username leads to failed authentication.

methods.name: authenticate_shouldNotAuthenticateGivenEmptyLogin
methods.description: Verify that empty string username leads to failed authentication.

methods.name: authenticate_shouldNotAuthenticateWhenPasswordInDatabaseIsNull
methods.description: Test that authentication fails when stored password is null.

methods.name: authenticate_shouldNotAuthenticateGivenNonNullPasswordWhenPasswordInDatabaseIsNull
methods.description: Test that providing a password when stored password is null leads to failure.

methods.name: authenticate_shouldNotAuthenticateGivenNullPasswordWhenPasswordInDatabaseIsNull
methods.description: Test that null password with null stored password fails authentication.

methods.name: authenticate_shouldNotAuthenticateWhenPasswordInDatabaseIsEmpty
methods.description: Test failure when provided password is empty while stored password is empty.

methods.name: authenticate_shouldGiveIdenticalErrorMessagesBetweenUsernameAndPasswordMismatch
methods.description: Verifies that error messages for username mismatch and password mismatch are consistent.

methods.name: authenticate_shouldLockoutUserAfterEightFailedAttempts
methods.description: Tests account lockout after 8 failed login attempts.

methods.name: authenticate_shouldAuthenticateWithCorrectHashedPassword
methods.description: Confirms authentication works with correct hashed password.

methods.name: authenticate_shouldAuthenticateWithIncorrectHashedPassword
methods.description: Confirms authentication works with an incorrectly hashed password, possibly bypassing hash validation as per the implementation.

methods.name: authenticate_shouldPassRegressionTestFor1580
methods.description: Regression test ensuring that failed login attempts are counted correctly even after a successful login.

methods.name: authenticate_shouldThrowAContextAuthenticationExceptionIfUsernameIsAnEmptyString
methods.description: Tests that an empty username string causes authentication failure.

methods.name: authenticate_shouldThrowAPIExceptionIfUsernameIsWhiteSpace
methods.description: Tests that whitespace username from the database triggers failure.

methods.name: should_mergeDefaultRuntimeProperties
methods.description: Validates that default runtime properties are merged correctly into provided properties.

methods.name: authenticate_shouldRightlyTriggerUserSessionListener_withSuccessfulLogin
methods.description: Verifies session listener triggers correctly on successful login.

methods.name: authenticate_shouldRightlyTriggerUserSessionListener_withFailedLogin
methods.description: Verifies session listener triggers correctly on failed login attempts.

methods.name: logout_shouldRightlyTriggerUserSessionListener
methods.description: Checks that user logout correctly triggers the session listener.
